figs.name: differential-pressure-transmitter-manifold-valve-sequence-flowchart
figs.alt: DP transmitter manifold valve sequence for commissioning and isolation with equalise valve
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the correct manifold valve order for a DP transmitter: open equalise first when commissioning and when taking it out of service.
figs.after_h2: Critical Installation Pitfalls: The Equalising Valve Sequence
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>DP transmitter manifold valve sequence for commissioning and taking out of service</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>

<rect x="410" y="58" width="370" height="420" rx="14" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>

<text x="205.0" y="134.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Open equalise</text>
<text x="205.0" y="158.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">DP = 0</text>
<rect x="445" y="108" width="300" height="64" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="595.0" y="134.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Open equalise</text>
<text x="595.0" y="158.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">DP goes to zero</text>
<line x1="205" y1="172" x2="205" y2="196" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>

<text x="205.0" y="236.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. Open HP block</text>

<text x="595.0" y="236.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. Close HP block</text>
<line x1="205" y1="262" x2="205" y2="286" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="595" y1="262" x2="595" y2="286" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>

<text x="205.0" y="326.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. Open LP block</text>
<rect x="445" y="288" width="300" height="64" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="595.0" y="326.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. Close LP block</text>
<line x1="205" y1="352" x2="205" y2="376" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="595" y1="352" x2="595" y2="376" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="55" y="378" width="300" height="64" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="404.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. Close equalise</text>
<text x="205.0" y="428.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">slowly, live DP</text>
<rect x="445" y="378" width="300" height="64" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="595.0" y="404.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. Close equalise</text>
<text x="595.0" y="428.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">fully isolated</text>
<rect x="20" y="490" width="760" height="58" rx="12" fill="#fef2f2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="514" font-size="18" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Wrong order puts full process pressure on one side only</text>
<text x="400" y="538" font-size="18" fill="#991b1b" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">and can over range or damage the sensing diaphragm.</text>
</svg>

figs.name: differential-pressure-transmitter-4-20-ma-output-infographic
figs.alt: differential pressure transmitter 4 to 20 mA formula with 30 kPa example giving 13.6 mA
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog with the DP to 4 to 20 mA formula and the article example: 30 kPa on a 0 to 50 kPa range gives 13.6 mA.
figs.after_h2: From Differential Pressure to 4-20 mA: The Output Signal
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>DP transmitter 4 to 20 mA output formula with worked example of 30 kPa on a 0 to 50 kPa range</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">DP to 4 to 20 mA: Worked Example</text>
<rect x="40" y="60" width="720" height="70" rx="14" fill="#0f766e"/>
<text x="400" y="104" font-size="22" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">I = 4 + [(DP minus LRV) ÷ (URV minus LRV)] × 16</text>
<rect x="40" y="150" width="172" height="100" rx="12" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="126" y="186" font-size="18" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Range</text>
<text x="126" y="225" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">0 to 50 kPa</text>
<rect x="222" y="150" width="172" height="100" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="308" y="186" font-size="18" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Measured DP</text>
<text x="308" y="225" font-size="20" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">30 kPa</text>
<rect x="404" y="150" width="172" height="100" rx="12" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="490" y="186" font-size="18" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fraction</text>
<text x="490" y="225" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">30 ÷ 50 = 0.60</text>
<rect x="586" y="150" width="172" height="100" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="672" y="186" font-size="18" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output</text>
<text x="672" y="225" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4 + 9.6 = 13.6 mA</text>
<text x="400" y="290" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output on the span</text>
<rect x="80" y="310" width="640" height="40" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="80" y="310" width="384" height="40" rx="8" fill="#0f766e"/>
<text x="272" y="337" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">60 percent of span</text>
<line x1="80" y1="350" x2="80" y2="365" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="80" y="388" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4 mA</text>
<line x1="400.0" y1="350" x2="400.0" y2="365" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="388" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">12 mA</text>
<line x1="720" y1="350" x2="720" y2="365" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="720" y="388" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">20 mA</text>
<line x1="464" y1="300" x2="464" y2="362" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3"/>
<text x="464" y="410" font-size="19" fill="#dc2626" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">13.6 mA</text>
<text x="80" y="420" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">0 kPa</text>
<text x="720" y="420" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">50 kPa</text>
<rect x="40" y="440" width="720" height="60" rx="12" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="466" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">HP equal to LP: 4 mA.  HP above LP: output rises toward 20 mA.</text>
<text x="400" y="490" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">For flow, 25 percent of DP span gives 50 percent flow and 12 mA.</text>
</svg>
